title: How AI Writing Assistance Distorts Perceptions of AI Users and Their Opinions
abstract: arXiv:2604.22503v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hundreds of millions of people use AI for writing assistance. We asked how AI distorts perceptions of AI users and their opinions. Writers (N=2,939) wrote political opinion paragraphs with and without AI assistance. Separate readers (N=11,091) blindly evaluated these paragraphs and made inferences about the writers. With AI, writers seemed more opinionated, competent, positive, and demographically privileged. Writers objected to many of these distortions yet preferred AI-assisted text even when made aware of them. Reward models trained on our data mitigated objectionable distortions but reduced user acceptance. Additional readers (N=8,798) trusted AI-assisted writers more and were more persuaded by AI writing when AI was more distortive. Overall, distortions from AI writing assistance are pervasive, persistent under human oversight, and likely to have consequential effects on human behaviours and attitudes.

translated_title: AI写作辅助如何扭曲人们对AI用户及其观点的认知
translated_abstract: 数亿人使用AI进行写作辅助。我们研究了AI如何扭曲人们对AI用户及其观点的认知。写作者（N=2,939）在有和没有AI辅助的情况下撰写政治观点段落。另一组读者（N=11,091）在不知情的情况下评估这些段落并对写作者做出推断。在AI辅助下，写作者显得更有主见、更有能力、态度更积极，且在社会人口学上更具优势。写作者对许多此类扭曲表示反对，但即使知晓这些扭曲的存在，他们仍然偏好AI辅助的文本。基于我们数据训练的奖励模型减轻了这些令人反感的扭曲，却降低了用户的接受度。另一批读者（N=8,798）更信任使用AI辅助的写作者，并且当AI的扭曲性更强时，他们反而更容易被AI写作说服。总体而言，AI写作辅助带来的认知扭曲是普遍存在的，在人类监督下依然持续，并且很可能对人类的行为和态度产生深远影响。
tldr: AI写作辅助会让读者对写作者产生普遍而持久的认知扭曲（显得更有主见、更有能力、更具社会优势），即使写作者本人反对且被明确告知，这些扭曲依然存在，而且扭曲越强反而越能增强说服力。
en_tdlr: AI writing assistance creates pervasive and persistent distortions in how readers perceive writers—making them seem more opinionated, competent, and privileged—distortions that writers object to yet still prefer, and stronger distortions paradoxically increase persuasion.
